rows.purpose: Once-per-frame game-thread tick (the photo-mode system's pre-update).
rows.evidence: Live: 235 calls in 2 s on the same thread as the camera commit; mirror prototype ran 1772 frames from it with zero faults.

rows.purpose: Create a game object from a loaded actor asset at a transform.
rows.evidence: Called by the photo-mode doppelganger spawn handler; live call returned an object with 16 components for the Miles actor.

rows.purpose: Activate freshly created objects so their components run and render.
rows.evidence: Live: object flags went 0x20A to 0x220B and the puppet rendered afterwards.

rows.purpose: Turn an object handle into a live object pointer, or null once it is gone.
rows.evidence: Live: resolved the puppet, and returned null one second after destroy.

rows.purpose: Move an actor to a new world transform.
rows.evidence: Live: puppet followed the hero for 1772 frames.

rows.purpose: Queue an object for the engine's deferred destroy.
rows.evidence: Live: puppet disappeared and its handle resolved to null; game stayed stable.

rows.purpose: Check that an actor asset is loaded before spawning from it.
rows.evidence: Live: returned the loaded Miles actor asset; returned null for assets that are not loaded.

rows.purpose: The look a RandomLook component has chosen: its list of body groups (mask, hood, body).
rows.evidence: Documented by norfmare's first-person mod for this build; live call on hero and double returned the same four groups.

rows.purpose: The actor that carries an object's visible suit model.
rows.evidence: Documented by norfmare's first-person mod; live call returned a separate visible actor for hero and double.

rows.purpose: Show a look's body groups on an actor.
rows.evidence: Live: the double had no head in the Homemade Suit until this call showed its mask.
